to choose, to select, to pick, to pick out
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: разобра́ть — to dismantle, to disassemble, to take apart, to deconstruct; выбира́ть — to choose, to select, to pick, to pick out; добра́ться — to get (to), to reach; убра́ть — to remove, to take away.

**берётся** — бра́ться (imperfective): to take something with hands, to take (mutually, together) (e.g. each other's hands); to set about; to undertake; (colloquial) to appear, to emerge. Wiktionary: брать + -ся.
